name: Tailscale VPN
author: John Myers
description: Manage Tailscale VPN connections for secure remote access to your FPP device

privacy.summary: Connects this player to your Tailscale network so your own devices can reach it from anywhere. Tailscale (tailscale.com) runs the sign-in and connection service.

sends.what: this player's name, network addresses and encryption keys
sends.why: to sign this player in to your Tailscale network
so your devices can reach this player and its web pages
to reach your devices when a direct connection isn't possible

collects.what: a log of connection events and sign-in links
this player's Tailscale identity and keys

systemChanges.what: installs Tailscale from tailscale.com, and reinstalls it when FPP starts if an FPP OS update removed it
adds Tailscale's apt package source and signing key
enables and runs Tailscale's background service (tailscaled), with its diagnostic log upload turned off
joins this player to your Tailscale network, so your Tailscale devices can reach it and FPP's web pages
adds a tailscale0 network interface, and uses networks your tailnet shares if you turn on subnet routes

privacy.other: Tailscale's diagnostic log upload is turned off, so Tailscale can't offer technical support for this player. Uninstalling logs this player out of Tailscale and removes the Tailscale package and its apt source.
